newsitem.title: USA: WinsLoew says Q2 EPS tops analysts views.
newsitem.headline: WinsLoew says Q2 EPS tops analysts views.

text.p: WinsLoew Furniture Inc said Wednesday it expects earnings for its second quarter ended June 28 to be higher than analyst estimates.
The company expects earnings per share to be about $0.60 per share, compared to $0.40 per share in the same period of last year.
Analysts consensus for the second quarter's earnings per share is $0.51, according to First Call.
The company expects to report its second quarter results the week of July 21.
An analysts conference call will be scheduled at that time.
